# Clutter repository instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the mandatory architecture and regression gate in [docs/implementation-rules.md §7](../docs/implementation-rules.md#7-mandatory-architecture-and-regression-gate-all-contributors-and-ai-agents) for every implementation task. This includes CSS, small fixes and direct-branch changes. Do not publish unverified runtime changes to shared development or main or bypass required tests. The isolated `testing/<task>` candidate exception in §7 is permitted only for verification, not promotion. If verification is unavailable or fails, stop and report the blocker. Follow the existing architecture and project constraints in [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md).
